BiblicalUsage: En-Shemesh is a place in Palestine. In Joshua 15:7, the text says "and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Shemesh matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Shemesh is one of them.
